# Solaris CET (Solaris Engineering)

Solaris CET is a Romania-based engineering and construction firm specializing in:
- Photovoltaic (solar PV) installations (residential and industrial)
- Industrial roofing with TPO membrane and specialized insulation
- Residential roofing (metal sheet, metal tiles, click systems)
- Metal parapets, facades, and architectural atics
- General construction works and structural repairs
- Technical maintenance and diagnostics

## Service Coverage

- Reach: Nationwide coverage in Romania for all project scales.
